description: Zinde connects ChatGPT with your Zinde account so you can review daily nutrition, water, steps, exercise, and goal progress in one place. Ask for a daily or weekly summary, get meal suggestions based on your remaining targets, update your goals, and log meals, water, or exercise after reviewing a preview.

defaultPrompt: How am I doing against my goals today?
Help me update my weight loss goals.
Add 3 eggs and 1 avocado to my food log.
